adjudication_note: Independent adversarial boundary holdout v3, frozen before C1E3 forensic review or C1F remediation design. Exact issuer identity, causal role, entity-versus-exposure, and unique-proxy requirements are adjudicated independently of relevance, materiality, and resolver coverage. DIRECT requires one exact principal traded issuer; PROXY requires no eligible direct issuer and one bounded principal exposure; all other cases abstain.

input.title: Alphabet says its YouTube business will close a creator-support office
input.summary: Alphabet Inc. identified itself as the legal employer and approved the closure of the office used solely by its YouTube division.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The evidence expressly links the YouTube division action to legal issuer Alphabet, though its listed share class remains ambiguous.

input.title: FreshMart recalls frozen meals from stores in three countries
input.summary: Different unrelated franchise groups trade as FreshMart, and the notice omits the legal operator, brand owner, jurisdiction, and exchange.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The causal retail brand is known, but no exact legal issuer can be inferred across unrelated FreshMart operators.

input.title: Amazon.com consolidates two AWS billing teams
input.summary: Amazon.com, Inc. filed the employment notice and states that AWS is the internal division whose teams will be combined.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The legal parent is explicit and directly makes the operating decision for its AWS division.

input.title: Mobility division suspends scooter rentals after a software fault
input.summary: The alert names only Mobility division and provides no parent, operator, brand, country, legal suffix, or exchange.

adjudicated_label.rationale: A causal operating unit is described, but its legal issuer identity cannot be determined from a generic division name.

input.title: NIKE, Inc. files a warehouse easement under legal name and NKE symbol
input.summary: The county filing names NIKE, Inc. as purchaser and includes NKE only as a cross-reference to the listed security.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The legal issuer is explicit and NKE is merely its corroborating trading symbol, not a separate entity.

input.title: ARM inspection completed after repetitive-motion complaints
input.summary: The workplace memo uses ARM as a body-part heading and names no semiconductor company, legal employer, exchange, or security.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The uppercase ticker-like string is anatomical language and does not identify Arm Holdings or another issuer.

input.title: Oil producers face a uniform increase in offshore royalty rates
input.summary: The enacted rule applies across crude producers and names Exxon and Chevron only as examples without assigning either distinct obligations.

adjudicated_label.rationale: No company has principal causal weight; the oil market is the one bounded exposure directly covered by the rule.

input.title: Semiconductor Capital Partners purchases a city-centre office
input.summary: The private property buyer happens to use Semiconductor in its legal name; the deal does not concern chip stocks, manufacturing, or a traded issuer.

adjudicated_label.rationale: A sector word inside a private company name does not create a semiconductor exposure or eligible direct issuer.

input.title: onsemi halts a sensor line while General Motors reports sufficient stock
input.summary: onsemi stated that contamination stopped its own production; General Motors said existing inventory prevents any current vehicle impact.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The exact traded supplier owns the stopped line and is the principal subject; the customer explicitly has no current effect.

input.title: Private display maker auctions patents; Apple and Microsoft named as possible bidders
input.summary: The seller has opened an auction, but neither listed company has registered, submitted a bid, or acknowledged interest.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The private supplier is the only actual actor; Apple and Microsoft are speculative customers with no causal role or confirmed exposure.

input.title: Visa terminates a processor; layoffs follow at the vendor
input.summary: Visa exercised the termination right in its contract; the vendor bears the layoffs and Mastercard appears only in a market-share chart.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Visa alone makes the causal contract decision; vendor layoffs are downstream and Mastercard is only contextual.

input.title: Private port operator delays cargo belonging to Netflix and eBay
input.summary: The operator reports different delays but provides no economic value, priority, contractual exposure, or basis for treating either customer as principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The private operator is causal and the evidence cannot identify one listed customer as the principal affected issuer.

input.title: Shell and BP equally fund and govern a new carbon-storage venture
input.summary: The executed venture agreement assigns each company half the capital, board seats, voting rights, and operating risk.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Shell and BP are equal causal principals, so the frozen policy must abstain from selecting either issuer.

input.title: Sony and Honda recall the same number of vehicles from their shared programme
input.summary: The coordinated notices impose identical repair costs and customer duties on both companies with no lead operator identified.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Both traded companies bear equal direct recall obligations and neither is identified as the unique principal.

input.title: Universal announces a debt exchange after lender talks
input.summary: The flash supplies no country, legal suffix, business description, exchange, or security identifier despite many unrelated Universal entities.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The event may be company-specific, but the exact causal legal issuer cannot be distinguished.

input.title: Block closes its payments service after a licensing dispute
input.summary: The notice does not say whether Block is Block, Inc., a local service branded Block, or a generic reference to a transaction block.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Payments context is insufficient to identify the exact causal legal entity behind the ambiguous Block name.

input.title: Netflix receives exclusive film-restoration rights; Roku appears in a valuation model
input.summary: The archive grants the rights solely to Netflix, while Roku is one of several comparables in an analyst's attached valuation table.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Netflix alone receives the operative rights; Roku is a contextual valuation comparable with no causal role.

input.title: Bank cyber standard cites Coinbase loss estimates in an explanatory annex
input.summary: The binding standard applies to deposit-taking banks; Coinbase figures illustrate prior incidents but no rule or finding applies to the company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Coinbase is contextual evidence rather than a principal or secondary affected issuer, and no bounded proxy fits the bank rule.

input.title: Corning changes bicycle-parking permits at one office
input.summary: Corning will issue new colour-coded permits to employees using racks at its company office; no other facility is affected.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Very low materiality does not alter the clear causal attribution to Corning's own workplace decision.

input.title: Coordinated refinery fires remove a quarter of regional fuel output
input.summary: The emergency report describes severe petroleum-market disruption but withholds every operator, owner, and listed company identity.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Despite high materiality, no issuer is identifiable and oil is the sole supported principal exposure.

input.title: Gold import duty takes effect at the largest bullion hub
input.summary: The duty applies specifically to physical gold transactions; jewellery retailers are discussed only as customers and no listed company is principal.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Physical gold is the unique principal exposure and related retailer demand does not create another principal.

input.title: Drought damages orange groves as report notes higher oil-based transport costs
input.summary: The crop loss is principal, while petroleum costs are one small input and no supported crop proxy or traded grower is identified.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Oil is related but not the principal subject, while the principal crop exposure has no bounded proxy.

input.title: Transaction levy applies equally to gold-backed funds and S&P 500 funds
input.summary: The enacted levy gives the two fund groups the same rate, effective date, and statutory prominence without selecting a primary market.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Gold and the S&P 500 exposures are co-equal statutory subjects, so neither proxy is uniquely principal.

input.title: Fund mandate equally tracks chip stocks and long-duration Treasuries
input.summary: The new mandate allocates exactly half to semiconductor stocks and half to US duration, with no dominant sleeve or causal company.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Two supported exposures are explicitly equal principals and policy cannot select one proxy.

input.title: Duolingo, Inc. closes one classroom certificate to new enrolments
input.summary: Duolingo, Inc. named itself as the legal provider and set the closure time for its own paid certificate programme.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The causal traded issuer is exact, but the frozen deterministic resolver has no Duolingo identity.

input.title: Schneider Electric SE recalls a named industrial relay
input.summary: Schneider Electric SE issued serial ranges and replacement instructions for relays sold under its legal manufacturer identity.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Schneider Electric SE is precisely identified as the recalling issuer, despite absent resolver coverage.

input.title: Chevron orders shutdown at the joint venture platform it operates
input.summary: Chevron holds operating authority and issued the shutdown order; minority partner Exxon Mobil did not vote or take a separate action.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Chevron is the uniquely causal operator issuing the shutdown; Exxon Mobil is an affected minority partner only.

input.title: BMW and Mercedes-Benz dissolve a jointly governed mobility venture
input.summary: Both companies approved the dissolution, share wind-down costs equally, and appoint the same number of liquidator representatives.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The joint-venture owners are equal causal principals and no lead issuer can be selected.

input.title: Microsoft exercises a call option for the remaining stake in a private joint venture
input.summary: The option agreement gives Microsoft sole discretion to trigger the purchase; the private founder disputes valuation but cannot prevent closing.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Microsoft is the only traded party and uniquely causes the acquisition by exercising its unilateral option.

input.title: Kroger and Albertsons terminate their merger and split the break costs
input.summary: The termination agreement records mutual consent, equal fees, and matching release obligations for both listed companies.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Buyer and target are equal causal parties to the termination, so neither is a unique principal issuer.

input.title: Crude shipping surcharge rises across all sanctioned routes
input.summary: The market-wide surcharge applies to petroleum cargoes; Occidental and Valero appear only as examples of companies analysts may monitor.

adjudicated_label.rationale: Oil shipping is the sole principal market exposure; example companies have no issuer-specific action or confirmed impact.

input.title: Semiconductor stocks receive a uniform capital-buffer recommendation
input.summary: The industry report addresses chip stocks collectively and lists NVIDIA and AMD solely to illustrate company sizes, without recommending distinct treatment.

adjudicated_label.rationale: The semiconductor group is the unique principal exposure and named issuers are non-causal examples.
